research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Getaround is focusing on developing vehicle access control services and platforms. This involves receiving vehicle reservations from wireless communication devices, authenticating these reservations, and providing access to vehicles post-authentication. These innovations aim to streamline the process of renting out cars by ensuring secure and efficient access control, aligning with Getaround's mission as a peer-to-peer car sharing marketplace.

overview_description.description: Getaround empowers users to instantly rent and drive great cars shared by people in their city. Cars can be rented by the hour, or the day, with a $1M insurance policy and 24/7 roadside assistance included. By using its app, people skip the lines and paperwork at traditional rental car counters, and the hassle of buying and maintaining a car. Powered by Getaround ConnectTM, the patented connected car technology, Getaround creates a fun and safe carsharing experience is without the need to meet the car owner, carry an access card, or coordinate picking up a car key. People share everything from a Prius to a Tesla and earn thousands in extra income each year, offsetting the high cost of car ownership while also making a positive impact on the environment.

product.name: Getaround Car-Sharing Marketplace
product.description: A peer-to-peer car rental marketplace where individuals and professional vehicle owners list cars for hourly or daily rentals, and drivers book nearby vehicles through the platform.

product.name: Getaround Connect
product.description: An in-car access and management technology that lets approved renters unlock and access vehicles with a smartphone, supporting contactless rentals and remote fleet operations.

identifier.value: Vehicle Owner and Fleet Management Service

product.name: Vehicle Owner and Fleet Management Service
product.description: A service for private owners and businesses to list vehicles, attract renters, manage availability, and monitor rental activity and profitability through an online account.

product.name: Getaround Insurance and Roadside Assistance
product.description: Rental-related insurance and assistance services covering eligible trips, including third-party liability, vehicle damage, fire, theft, and breakdown or accident support.

product.name: Getaround Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application for discovering and booking vehicles, managing rentals, completing vehicle inspections, and unlocking compatible cars with a smartphone.
